scenes.text: The highest common factor is the largest number that divides both numbers. Factor trees and prime factors help.
Find HCF(10, 15). The answer is 5. Highest common factor equals 5.
Two groups during a sports day hold 32 and 15 items. What is the greatest size of identical packets that divides both totals? Pause to choose and explain.
Two groups during a sports day hold 32 and 15 items. What is the greatest size of identical packets that divides both totals? The answer is 1. Highest common factor equals 1.
